evals.name: minimal-currency-and-cache
evals.prompt: Implement a helper that formats currency for the dashboard and a per-request cache for user lookups. Use the existing code in src/lib/utils.js. Keep the change as small as possible.
evals.expected_output: Minimal implementation using Intl.NumberFormat, no new dependencies, reuses or removes existing helpers, rejects a speculative cache, and states a complexity budget.
assertions: Uses Intl.NumberFormat or platform formatting instead of adding a dependency
Does not add a caching layer without a measured need, or explicitly rejects it
Deletes or avoids speculative abstractions and unused helpers
States a complexity budget covering dependencies, abstractions, and config
Keeps the diff small and readable
